completion_gates: All 20 designated cities are represented by two reviewed reference implementations or one of eighteen municipality-specific declared Phase 13 v1 completion contracts.
All 18 municipalities in the canonical execution queue are reviewed_complete, with zero review_in_progress, zero pending_record_review, and zero blocked source inventories.
Each promoted completion contract preserves official-source lineage, evidence roles, plan versions, reporting periods, fiscal states, and explicit deferred-depth boundaries.
Not-yet-published, unresolved, historical-only, rounded-source, and source-reported evaluation states remain explicit instead of being replaced by inferred values or false precision.
Municipal self-evaluations, external deliberation, fiscal values, KPIs, and outcome indicators are not converted into independent Jichi Insight policy-achievement judgments or causal claims.

Cross-city comparison eligibility and rankings remain outside Phase 13 unless a separate comparability methodology verifies that the underlying definitions, populations, periods, and units are comparable.
The final canonical queue, all municipality completion contracts, JSON Schemas, repository validation, regression tests, web checks, and production smoke must pass on the final merged head.
completion_boundary: Phase 13 completes the designated-city v1 record-review foundation for all 20 designated cities: Kitakyushu and Fukuoka remain reviewed reference implementations, while all 18 municipalities in the execution queue have municipality-specific reviewed_complete contracts at their declared maximum v1 depth. Completion does not mean that every policy, KPI, project, contract, subsidy, budget line, settlement line, assembly statement, audit finding, or multi-year result has been fully linked. Each city explicitly records deferred depth, not-yet-published or unresolved evidence, version boundaries, fiscal states, and source precision. No independent Jichi Insight policy-achievement judgment, causal attribution, unverified cross-city comparison, or ranking is introduced by Phase 13 completion.
